event.desc: Studenter-Sangforeningen toured Southern Jutland with the same programme.
The concert was repeated on 11 May.

history.p: The song had its first performance at a carnival in Casino in 1854, where the students collected money for a new building for Studenterforeningen. This did not become a reality until 1863. The song was so popular that it was incorporated in all editions of the songbook of Studenter-Sangforeningen until 1890.
